meaning:
1) leanness, scantness, wasting
1a) leanness
1b) wasting (of disease)
1c) scantness (of measure)

elsewhere.note: He gave them their request, but sent leanness into their soul.
Therefore the Lord, Yahweh of Armies, will send among his fat ones leanness; and under his glory a burning will be kindled like the burning of fire.
Are there yet treasures of wickedness in the house of the wicked, and a short ephah that is accursed?
